label: Distance to nearest settlement
aliases: ["distance to market", "distance from settlement", "distance to town", "distance to village", "settlement proximity", "market proximity"]
comment: Euclidean distance to built-up/settlement. distance_to_market is SYNONYMOUS (rural settlement≈market) — folded here as an alias. Distinct from accessibility_travel_time (friction/travel-time, not euclidean). Dataset binding pending (Benson). #103.

label: Distance to nearest waterbody
aliases: ["distance to water", "distance from waterbody", "river proximity", "stream proximity"]
raised_by: issue_103; unit revised by the riparian T4 sweep 2026-09-25
comment: Outward distance from the watercourse. For riparian_buffer (spatial_product_type=zonal_linear) this is the band half-width that defines the opportunity zone, and ALL 13 evidence units state it in metres (statutory reserves 30-50 m, design widths 5-30 m, delineation maxima 200-210 m) - so the canonical unit is m, not km (changed 2026-09-25; the variable is used by no other NbS, no BIND row and no other recipe, so the change has no blast radius). min_meaningful_resolution lowered 100->30 to match the evidence. CAVEAT for dataset-fitness sign-off: a 30 m band cannot be resolved from a ~90 m global stream network - record as a scoping-grade limitation. Distinct from riparian_buffer_width, which is the width of the EXISTING buffer (a restoration-priority indicator, not the zone definition). #103.

label: Distance to nearest cropland
comment: Euclidean distance to cropland. Dataset binding pending. #103.

label: Distance to nearest forest
aliases: ["distance to forest", "distance from forest", "forest edge proximity"]
comment: Euclidean distance to forest/tree cover. Dataset binding pending. #103.

label: Minimum restorable patch area
comment: Minimum contiguous area for a restoration site to be worth prioritising (Russell 1997 uses 1 ha for flood attenuation, and states the threshold was arbitrarily defined). Distinct from forest_fragment_size, which measures an existing seed-source patch.

label: field boundary zone
comment: Buffered field boundaries; geometry plus regionally justified width required.

label: grazing system present
comment: Grazing management confirmation; GPW grassland and GLW4 ruminants are supporting inputs, not direct proof.

label: managed forage without grazing
comment: Forage management without grazing; grassland class alone is insufficient.

label: Agricultural / fallow / former farmland context
comment: Validated agricultural land-use context; independent of degradation. Required for non-cropland FMNR branches.

label: Distance to market
comment: Separate distance measure from distance to road and accessibility travel time. CRS 2025 Table 2 does not specify unit, route metric or district reference point; km is proposed ontology unit, not a source-unit assertion. No dataset binding or numeric rule authorized.

label: Farm assets / equipment index
comment: Farm asset ownership/wealth proxy is distinct from credit access. Source index construction and spatial representation need review; no binding or runtime rule.

label: Gender differences in participation / adoption
comment: Study-level participation comparison; distinct from national gender index. No inferred common effect scale or spatial binding.

label: Access to land
comment: Ability to access land for adoption, distinct from tenure security. Qualitative source evidence; no spatial dataset binding.
